name: Shortlist
summary: A job listing card with a three-step apply flow, real CV reading and a live application tracker
about: A job card for a design role in Karachi with salary range, perks and a save bookmark that hops. Apply opens a three-step flow in the same card: your details with real validation, a CV drop zone that actually reads the file (page count for PDFs, word count for text) and a short note. Sending folds the form into a sheet that drops into the studio's tray, then a tracker lights up step by step until you can book an interview slot.
how: Tap the bookmark to save the job; tap Apply now to start.
Fill in your name and email: mistakes shake the field and explain what is wrong.
Drop or browse for a CV (up to 5 MB), or use the sample CV link.
Write a short note, pick when you can start and press Send application.
Watch the tracker go from Sent to Seen to Shortlisted, then pick an interview slot; Withdraw resets everything.
